facts.fact: Le Brief reports the ANSS annual report as saying that crossing the national population register (RNP) with the unified social registry (RSU) concentrates 84% of Direct Social Aid payments on the three poorest deciles.

Le Brief reports that the implementing decree for a monthly MAD 500 special aid for orphans, paid into an interest-bearing account in each child's name at the CDG, was adopted on 23 December 2025, with enrolment to finish in 2026.
